jobs.occupation: (Senior) Equipment Technician (m/f/d) (Industriemechaniker/in)
jobs.description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem.

For our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and committed:

Advanced Equipment Technician (m/f/d)

We are building a team and are looking for skilled Advanced Equipment Technicians (m/f/d) to become the backbone of our manufacturing process. In this dynamic role, you will go beyond basic maintenance. You will tackle complex equipment challenges, ensure top-tier quality, and step up as a leader and mentor to our junior technicians. You are a natural problem-solver who loves mastering complex tools and is passionate about mentoring others and driving continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities
• Execute advanced preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshoot complex, high-level equipment issues with minimal engineering guidance
• Act as a mentor! Lead junior technicians in daily PM and troubleshooting activities, ensure checklists are flawlessly completed, and coach newcomers to success
• Have an eagle eye for detail? You will identify subtle equipment deviations (e.g., rough movements, worn components), report abnormalities, and help drive process stability
• Contribute directly to our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and demonstrate basic tool troubleshooting for the wider team
• Take ownership of the parts lifecycle - managing scrapped parts and ensuring our inventory is always sufficient and ready to go
• Identify safety risks, create basic safety SOPs, and provide essential safety training to keep your team secure

Your profile
• Successfully completed vocational training in an industrial or mechanical field (IHK certified: Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker or Elektriker)
• At least 3 years of professional experience in a manufacturing environment
• Practical English skills (Level B1). You must be able to read technical documentation, complete your interview in English
• You are highly reliable, structured, and safety-oriented
• A team-oriented mindset with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and grow with us
• Ability and willingness to work an 8-hour shift model, which includes nights, weekends, and sometimes public holidays
• Willing to travel to Taiwan for a 6 - 9 month comprehensive training program
• Semiconductor industry experience is nice to have

Reasons to join ESMC
• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.
• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits : We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.
• Training & Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.
• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.
• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket) in Germany.

About usEach journey starts with a first step.
Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.
Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).
We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.
At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

jobs.occupation: Optical Architect (d/f/m) for Optical Instruments (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for an

Optical Architect (d/f/m)

You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. These developments cover instruments for ESA, CNES, DLR and EU programmes across the spectral range from ultraviolet to thermal infrared. Examples include LIDARs (ATLID, MERLIN), Multi-Spectral Instruments (Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-4, Sentinel-5) from the Copernicus programme, infrared instruments (LSTM, TRISHNA), meteorological instruments (IASI-NG and METimage) embarked on MetOp-SG, instruments for scientific missions like EUCLID, cameras embarked on LEO and GEO satellites, and national programmes.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria.

Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and develop optical subsystem architecture and verification strategies for space-borne instruments in project phases B2, C, and D following defined processes.
- Act as the main technical contact point for optical domain matters, supporting systems engineers on technological, design, verification, risk, cost, and schedule aspects.
- Perform optical design and analysis, including stray light analysis, optical layout, tolerances, and stray light, thermal, and optical performance (STOP) budget allocations.
- Coordinate optical subsystem engineering and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) activities across multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Thermal, Electrical, Detection-chain, Cleanliness).
- Derive, consolidate, and maintain optical subsystem requirements in alignment with higher-level specifications (e.g., SRD, IRD) and verification plans.
- Oversee subcontracted optical equipment procurement, reviewing data packages and test plans to ensure on-time, on-cost, and on-quality delivery.
- Contribute to future programmes (phase 0 or A/B1), support internal/external R&D proposals for new optical technologies, and participate in lessons-learnt exchanges.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering
- Proven multi-year experience in optical instrumentation or optical sensors, ideally for space applications
- Solid experience in optical layout, design, tolerance, and STOP analysis, including maintenance of optical allocations/budgets.
- Proficiency with commercial optical design software (e.g., Code V, Zemax, FRED) and programming languages (e.g., Matlab, Python).
- Sound technical knowledge of optical components (e.g., mirrors, photonics, gratings, fibers, lasers, coatings) and space equipment alignment/testing strategies.
- Strong communication skills, collaborative problem-solving approach, and experience in managing suppliers or subcontractors.
- Professional working proficiency in English; knowledge of German is beneficial.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Lab Technician (Biologielaborant/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.

In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.
Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.
In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.

Your Tasks

- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics
- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections
- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces
- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection
- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing
- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members
- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partners

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training as a laboratory technician or an equivalent qualification
- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization
- Ideally, experience with inventory management, procurement, equipment coordination, and laboratory documentation
- Knowledge of occupational safety, biosafety, and relevant documentation requirements is an advantage
- Independent, structured, and reliable working style with strong organizational skills
- Very good communication and coordination skills when working with scientists, students, internal service units, and external partners
- Motivation to work in a diverse role combining hands-on laboratory work with administrative and organizational responsibilities
- Very good written and spoken English and German

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments

Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.

Munich Re's Facultative and Corporate business unit (MR F&C) manages our global facultative reinsurance and direct insurance portfolio across Property, Engineering, Energy, Casualty, Cyber, and New Risk Solutions. Since 2019, MR F&C has grown significantly and invested in innovative initiatives. A robust, end-to-end operating platform with an integrated systems and data landscape, standardized global processes, and a foundation for AI capabilities is central to our strategy. We are seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst to help deliver these ambitions, with a focus on end-to-end support for our global Casualty underwriting teams.
Your Job

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).

• Speech and Language Therapists.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

**Ground Test Engineer (d/f/m) - Engineering Ground Test on Aircraft **

You will join the Ground Test team, which is part of the Flight Test Center of AIRBUS Helicopters Germany. Our team performs development, certification, and qualification testing activities on aircraft on ground. It comprises the domains electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), avionics and vehicle mission systems, vibrations, and acoustics.
Our main goal is to ensure system maturity for by making the bridge between avionic/vehicle rigs and flight tests. In order to do that we optimize integration and test sequence in close relationship with design office, simulation, rigs, flight-test crews, and prototype shops. Finally, we show compliance with regulations specifications or certification/qualification requirements, in order to get our aircraft certified.

Your location:

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits:

- Attractive salary including holiday pay, Christmas bonus and profit sharing
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, public transport subsidy, discounts at local businesses, and further additional company benefits such as Job Bike and Wellpass
- On-site-facilities: medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteens and cafeterias

Your tasks and responsibilities:

- Organizing, preparing, and performing ground test activities on various helicopters of the AIRBUS Helicopters fleet (development and certification) with related interfaces (Chief Engineering/Project, Prototype Shop, Design department or Helicopter Test Coordinator/Test Squad Leader)
- Being responsible for ground test activities mainly for EMC, and in addition for vibration and acoustic tests for civil and military platforms
- Analyzing and validating the test data with immediate debriefing and report before the flight tests
- Writing of technical reports and follow up of respective problem analysis
- Supporting to aircraft troubleshooting and ensuring testing expertise
- Following technological evolution for new systems, functions, testing tools and means

Desired skills and qualifications:

- Engineering degree in mechatronics / electrical engineering / communications engineering or technical degree (e.g. completed technical vocational training and Technikerschule)
- Capability to undergo a Sicherheitsüberprüfung, at minimum Ü2
- At least 5–10 years of professional experience in a technically relevant area of electrical or communications engineering, design, development or a similar field
- Strong interest or experience in avionic systems, radios, test or simulation tools is an advantage
- Innovative thinking, tenacity, adaptability, flexibility, and teamwork skills
- Very good analysis and excellent communication skills
- High resilience and ability to work in a daily changing and highly dynamic environment
- Language skills: Fluent in German and English.

jobs.occupation: Junior Simulation Software Developer C/C++ (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

The A400M is a versatile European tactical airlifter that bridges the gap between traditional transport aircraft and strategic airlift capabilities. It stands as a symbol of industrial excellence and collaborative defense capability.

Be part of this journey and join our team to shape the future of A400M simulation! We develop advanced simulation software for the A400M programme, ranging from high-fidelity Full Flight Simulators (FFS) for pilot training to advanced test facilities for avionics integration and certification. We support the A400M Military Test and Support Facility (MTSF) by providing simulation models that enable the verification and certification of avionics at software, equipment, and system levels. Our work ensures that aircraft updates are accurately represented in both training and test environments, utilizing a tech stack centered on C/C++.

As a Junior Software Engineer in our MTSF team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of simulation solutions. You will translate high‑level operational and system requirements from a variety of stakeholders into robust simulation models, design and define the necessary simulation interfaces, develop and test complex models, and drive the successful release and deployment of those models. Throughout the process you will guarantee high‑quality delivery and provide support during customer‑acceptance activities.

Your location:

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits:

- Attractive salary including holiday pay, Christmas bonus and profit sharing
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, public transport subsidy, discounts at local businesses
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten nearby

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing simulation models based on avionics software to accurately represent aircraft equipment and systems
- Working closely with customers from aircraft development
- Providing solutions to support testing of real aircraft equipment
- Implementing robust real time software components, primarily using C, and integrating both in-house and third-party modules
- Create requirements, test procedures and supporting documentation and perform formal acceptances
- Designing and defining simulation interfaces in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
- Driving development excellence by creating tools for automation, code generation, and optimized build pipelines
- Supporting the entire deployment cycle, from initial model development to successful integration and customer acceptance
- Working internationally gives you the opportunity to travel occasionally to meet partners on‑site.

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

Education:

- We are looking for candidates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline

Professional Experience:

- Relevant experience in the field of software development: - Software design
- Procedural and object orientated programming
- Unit, integration and system testing
- Your proficiency in C/C++ and knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks will be instrumental in this role

Technical Skills:

- Profound knowledge of C/C++
- Knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks
- Scripting languages (e.g. Bash, Python)
- Build Systems (e.g. CMake) and packaging (e.g. conan.io, RPM, DEB)
- Proficiency with Linux and Windows
- Experience with version control systems, office applications, and Atlassian tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira)
- Experience with CI/CD or DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins) and software development (e.g., VS Code)
- Experience with Avionics buses would be a plus
- Experience with real time applications would be a plus

Work Methods and Soft Skills:

- Familiarity and agreement with agile working methods
- Ability to work in large teams and be an excellent team player
- Ability to work independently
- Proactive approach

Language Skills:

- English: Business fluent
- German, Spanish, French or Italian are a plus

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
